name: Sarla Performance Fibers Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Sarla Performance Fibers Ltd manufactures various types of polyester and nylon yarns[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SPFL is an ISO 9001:2015, Oeko Tex  Standard certified and 100% EOU engaged in manufacturing and export of polyester and nylon textured, twisted and dyed yarns, covered yarns, high tenacity yarns and sewing thread. It has nylon and polyester product range of over 250 varieties of value added yarns  and threads

pros: Stock is providing a good dividend yield of 3.38%.
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.45% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.33% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.35.2 Cr.
Dividend payout has been low at 13.4% of profits over last 3 years
